name: XDKNet 2.4.10
body:
Android TV 2.4.10, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.0.9.0 (Emby 2.0.4.0).

**On 2.4.9, update from Settings > About > Check for updates, then Download.**
On its own, 2.4.9 only shows a short notice that the remote cannot select.
Anything older than 2.4.9 has to install this once by hand, from the
`XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below. From 2.4.10 on, the TV asks by itself.

## Updates

**The TV asks about a new version with a dialog you can use with the remote.**
It shows the release notes, with "Update now" focused and "Later" next to it.
Before, the only prompt was a pill that could not take focus and disappeared
after a few seconds. If you choose "Later", Settings > About still shows that
an update is waiting.

**A download is checked before it is installed.** Its size and SHA-256 must
match the release, so a cut-off or wrong file is never installed. The update
dialog now always has a button to press and Back works throughout. It says
what went wrong when Android refuses the install (cancelled, not enough
space, signed differently) instead of sitting at 100% until the app is
force-stopped.

**Phone and desktop builds no longer offer the TV build as their update.**

## Fixed, on Android TV

**Back works as it should on Chromecast with Google TV, Google TV Streamer and
other Android 13+ TVs.** It collapses an expanded overview and jumps back to
the All chip in grids again, as it does on the Shield.

**No notification permission prompt over the login screen on Google TV.** TVs
never ask for it now.

**Titles you remove from Continue watching stay removed** until you play them
again or the next episode changes.

**The hourly Continue watching refresh no longer starts a hidden copy of the
app.** That copy could leave HDR, codec and audio passthrough detection
missing the next time the app opened. The refresh also pauses while the app
is open or anything is playing.

**The TV can go to sleep.** The screensaver has a new "Turn Screen Off After"
setting, 30 minutes by default. After that the TV's own ambient mode or
display-off timer takes over instead of the artwork staying lit all night.

**Guide and Last/Recall buttons work in Live TV.** Guide opens the channel
guide, and Last goes back to the previous channel.

**Casting to DLNA:** titles with "&" in them play on strict renderers. A bad
request from another device on the network can no longer crash the app
mid-cast.

## Fixed, on TV and in the web app

**Blocked parental ratings are hidden everywhere.** This covers library grids,
search, the media bar, collections, genre and person pages, Favorites,
Shuffle, Next Up and Continue watching (using the show's rating), and Seerr
and IMDb list rows. Before, only the Home rows were filtered.

**Thumb and Banner library views sync between devices on Jellyfin again.**

## Security

- Artwork shared with the launcher, Android Auto and media controls no longer
  carries your server sign-in.
- Only trusted apps (system UI, Bluetooth, Assistant, launchers) can control
  or read the video player's media session. Only the app itself can use the
  picture-in-picture play/pause button.
- Books cannot run scripts in the reader.
- Emulator cores are downloaded only from libretro over verified HTTPS, and
  checked before they are loaded.
- Plugin settings only give your admin sign-in to your server's own pages.

Pair with plugin 2.0.9.0.
